name: pitchmyweb
description: PitchMyWeb monorepo: marketing + dashboard web app, API, WhatsApp worker, shared packages

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/sites
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/sites
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/contracts && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/whatsapp-worker && npm run test -w apps/recorder-worker && npm run test -w apps/discovery-worker && npm run test -w apps/verification-worker && npm run test -w apps/sites
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/db && npm run typecheck -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck -w packages/templates && npm run typecheck -w packages/storage && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/whatsapp-worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/recorder-worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/discovery-worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/verification-worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/sites && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
